scientific_question: 订单在执行中新增、取消或改变需求且已经出发的整趟路线不可撤回时，静态路线策略的实际成本恶化多少，严格滚动重规划能挽回多少；协同、参与保障和时变碳是否真实进入事件后的决策。

original_four_arm_design.B1_STATIC_HINDSIGHT: 终局已知全部事件后一次性静态求解；不经历在线执行，用于信息成本下界。
original_four_arm_design.B2_FULL_ROLLING: 滚动重规划，协同开放，碳感知充电，逐阶段参与保障。
original_four_arm_design.B3_NO_COOPERATION: 与 B2 相同，但客户只能由冻结责任车场服务。
original_four_arm_design.B4_CARBON_BLIND: 与 B2 相同，但每次重规划后使用最早可行充电时刻。
original_four_arm_design.current_feasibility_finding: B2-B4 的严格物理状态框架可复用；B1 技术上可构造，但不经历不可撤回执行，不能回答本任务指定的静态方案受扰后实际表现。当前代码也没有把 China81 的动态新增节点自动接入冻结有向道路矩阵的现成桥接层。

registered_replacement_design.reason: 以固定路线的因果在线实际表现替换后见全知下界，使主对照直接回答本任务的核心问题；其余三臂保持原设计的结构语义。

arms.semantics: 从扰动前冻结方案执行；事件只允许删除尚未执行的取消订单、更新尚未执行订单的需求，并把新增或因需求变化而失配的订单放入所属车场的独立补救趟。不得改变其他未执行路线的客户顺序、服务车场或路线组合；随后只做精确物理车辆排程和碳感知充电择时，不运行路线搜索。
arms.fairness: audited_not_search-enforced; any member loss is reported

arms.semantics: 严格滚动重规划；已出发整趟路线、已开始充电及物理车辆可用时刻/电量冻结；开放跨场重分配，候选须不劣于同状态无协同基准的每个成员收益，并在物理窗口内使用碳感知充电。
与 FULL_ROLLING 相同的事件、冻结状态、起点和预算，但新增跨场服务禁止，客户由冻结责任车场服务。
与 FULL_ROLLING 相同的事件、冻结状态、协同和参与保障，但所有未锁充电动作使用最早可行时刻。

instances.nominal_plan_source: E3 sealed JOINT plan with the same algorithm seed
E3 sealed JOINT plan with the same algorithm seed
mechanism_foundation frozen mismatch00 common initial solution; E3 has no sealed 150c JOINT result, so this scale is stress evidence only

event_stream_assignment.reason: uses every frozen stream exactly twice across seeds 1-10 without selecting by outcome

event_injection.add: create the frozen new customer with donor demand, time window, service time and coordinates
event_injection.cancel: remove only if the target has not departed; otherwise record as ignored_locked_event
event_injection.demand_change: change only if the target has not departed; otherwise record as ignored_locked_event
event_injection.road_metric_rule: Every add event is an exact same-instance donor-location clone. Clone the donor's inbound/outbound entries in the frozen directed distance matrix and both CV/EV road-profile matrices. Euclidean fallback is forbidden.
event_injection.owner_rule: new customer inherits its donor customer's frozen ZONE responsibility owner

immutable: physical vehicle home depot and type
irreversibility.editable: only trips not yet departed and charging actions not yet started
irreversibility.no_lookahead: a stage sees only events released by its trigger

budget.unit: complete candidate evaluations per rolling stage across the same-state shadow reference plus released-policy search

probe.trace: strict complete-candidate best-so-far trace; null objective is a legal infeasible evaluation
probe.selection_rule: Take the later of the shadow and released-search last strict improvement indices, round up to the next 100, and require at least 100. If the later index exceeds 720, run one preregistered extension at 1600 per pass; if it exceeds 1440, HALT_NEEDS_LONGER_BUDGET_DECISION.

budget.formal_allocation_after_probe: half of the selected total stage cap to the same-state no-cooperation reference and half to the released-policy search; STATIC_FIXED_RECOURSE consumes no route-search evaluations and remains below the same cap
budget.actual_consumption_rule: actual stage evaluations must be <= selected_total_stage_cap; early stop or null objective is not a fault

primary_metrics.nominal_cost: cost of the pre-event frozen plan
primary_metrics.dynamic_recovery_pct: 100 * (STATIC_FIXED_RECOURSE - FULL_ROLLING) / (STATIC_FIXED_RECOURSE - nominal); null when the denominator is zero

mechanism_participation_tests.cross_depot_reassignment: event-time owner/serving-depot changes after a trigger, excluding inherited pre-event cross-site services
mechanism_participation_tests.member_profit_shift: at least one depot's cumulative profit changes across an event stage or differs between FULL_ROLLING and its same-state reference
mechanism_participation_tests.carbon_aware_charging_shift: at least one unlocked charging action moves away from earliest feasible time and FULL_ROLLING has lower weighted charging carbon intensity than CARBON_BLIND

hard_halts: event stream or nominal plan hash drift
Euclidean distance fallback for an added China81 customer
